Arrival Checks for Companion Animal Travel Desk

Use this guide at once if you are preparing to travel with an animal on Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews each case with care, and you must present clear details before departure. Bring the animal early, keep the carrier secure, and follow every instruction from the staff without delay.

The welfare coordinator will review comfort needs and check that the animal can travel safely in the carrier. <<FACT F064>> The ground team then handles the carrier with care as it moves through service points, and the welcome team prepares you for boarding after the check is complete. If your animal appears unsettled, report it immediately so the team can respond before the next step.

Keep travel documents ready and make sure the carrier is clean, firm, and well ventilated. Do not add extra items unless staff approve them in advance. If the animal needs water, food, or a pause, tell the desk before arrival checks begin. Calm handling helps the process move faster and reduces stress for the animal.

If you are traveling with more than one approved animal, remain with the staff and follow their directions closely. Any delay in presenting the carrier, or any missing detail, may affect acceptance for the trip. Act at once if you notice damage to the carrier, signs of distress, or a change in the animal's condition.

For further help, contact Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
